description: Inventory of Landslides Along Alabama Highways is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Jack Montgomery, Auburn University (auburn.edu). An inventory of landslides along Alabama highways was created using both inclinometer readings collected by the Alabama Department of Transportation and based on Detailed Damage Inspection Reports (DDIRs) submitted to the Federal Highway Administration (FHWA) for emergency assistance. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 4 top-level files (CSV, KML, TXT). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-xs04-th22. Keywords: Landslides, Highways, Inclinometers. Published 2025-07-12. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
